purpose: Project recorded runtime evidence into mechanically applicable response candidates without choosing, ranking, executing, or mutating any Resolution state.

input_boundary.admission_requirement: evidence must already have been recorded in an exact-subject ResolutionEvidenceInbox
input_boundary.foreign_or_stale_evidence: must be rejected by the inbox before interpretation

ignore.meaning: keep the evidence recorded and make no Resolution mutation from this evidence

reverify.meaning: invoke the appropriate existing runtime verifier again outside this projection

request_information.meaning: request external clarification/context; this projection does not create a ResolutionDiagnostic

propose_revision.meaning: open a fresh existing Resolution revision workflow outside this projection

selection_policy.ordering: stable protocol order only; not preference
selection_policy.authority: caller/agent remains responsible for choosing whether any candidate should be used

availability_semantics.available_true: the recorded evidence mechanically supports this response class
availability_semantics.available_false: this evidence does not itself expose this response class through the interpretation projection
availability_semantics.escape_hatch: available=false does not prohibit callers from using independent review/revision APIs for other reasons

invariants: interpretation only reads evidence already admitted to an exact-subject inbox
propose_revision never opens a revision automatically
reverify never invokes a verifier automatically
passed evidence does not become a prohibition against independent revision APIs
failed evidence does not automatically imply revision
candidate availability and explicit caller selection remain separate: interpretation proposes possibilities, ResponseIntent records the caller/agent choice
a committed revision execution receipt does not mechanically derive another revision proposal

selection_handoff.rule: only an available evidence-derived candidate can become ResponseIntent; the interpreter itself still selects nothing
